lines.x: International copper prices fell to a seven-month low following volatility in technology stocks, threatening export revenue projections in major producers like Peru.
The Peruvian sol fell 0.52% to close at 3.451 per US dollar.
Chilean telecommunications company Entel agreed to sell 100% of its Peruvian subsidiary to Luxembourg-based Millicom for $1.714 billion.
Interest rate adjustments by Peru's Central Reserve Bank (BCRP) have increased mortgage financing rates across commercial banks, raising costs for prospective home buyers.
